title.en: Command Code tools for DeepSeek Harness
title.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Command Code 工具

description.en: Plugins by miko-cn for DeepSeek Harness. Add this file as an index source under Plugins → Discover.
description.zh: miko-cn 开发的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。把本文件添加为 Plugins → Discover 里的索引源即可浏览与安装。

description.en: Plan credits, 5-hour and weekly windows, period request stats, plan tiers and an in-app API-key editor for Command Code — a Settings tab plus a draggable floating capsule. Requires your own Command Code account or API key.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里查看 Command Code 的套餐额度、5 小时 / 每周滚动窗口、本期请求统计与套餐档位，含设置页签与可拖动的浮窗胶囊，并内置 API key 管理。需要自己的 Command Code 账号 / API key。
